description: This file defines the Route53ProfilesClient class, which extends AwsClient, and provides methods for interacting with the Route 53 Profiles service in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various operations such as associating profiles and resources, creating, deleting, and listing profiles and their associations.

classes.name: Route53ProfilesClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Route 53 Profiles service, extending AwsClient with additional method annotations for available operations.
